rationale: Evaluating prevention of omitted required braking maneuvers requires characterising whether the vehicle initiates and performs braking when needed for collision avoidance. SG-1 and FR-7 establish braking response itself as the subject of evaluation, rather than merely a mechanism affecting another phenomenon. The obstacle-related scope is supported by the requirements and H-1. P does not extend to sensing, computation, communication, failure-management mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “Vehicle/system braking response” directly addresses the braking-omission target established by SG-1 and H-1.
“Whether braking is initiated and performed” characterises occurrence or omission of the required maneuver, supported by FR-7 and the braking-initiation requirement FR-7.1.
“When an obstacle requires avoidance,” read with the declared scope, limits the response to situations potentially requiring braking to avoid collision.
The scope includes the pedestrian encounter specified in H-1; its broader inclusion of road users and obstacles is supported by H-1's hazardous event and FR-7.
